about_the_game:
Welcome to the world of Molten Maze — an exciting 3D platformer-puzzle, where every movement you make matters!
Prepare for an incredible challenge, as beneath your feet lies not just a floor, but a seething lava terrain!

In this game, you'll need to become a master of strategy, adaptation, and ingenuity.
Each level offers unique challenges where you must move blocks to create a safe path to the exit. Lava is everywhere: it floods the ground, and every wrong step could be fatal!
But don't worry! The puzzles will help develop your logical thinking and provide countless hours of engaging gameplay.

Game Features:

Captivating 3D gameplay
Unique levels
Strategic thinking
Logical puzzles
Intuitive controls
